title: Sakada Day.
bodyText: December 20 of each year shall be known and designated as "Sakada Day"; provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-18.5]  Sakada Day.  December 20 of each year shall be known and designated as "Sakada Day"; provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 2015, c 7, §2]
